items.title: Microsoft Teams: External bot detection and activity reports in Admin Center
items.text: Admins should be able to track the detection and meeting access activity of external bots in the meetings and events hosted in their tenant.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
items.text: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource .

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
items.text: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
items.text: Admin should be able to see the Endpoint DLP policy sync status on the Purview portal within 30 mins.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat
items.text: Available for M365 users without a M365 Copilot license. From Chat, you can use natural language to generate and direct edits to new and existing documents, when in an Edit mode. In this mode, Copilot will ask clarifying questions if needed, and after making changes will recap actions take and recommended next steps. Changes to the document are supported with controls in the document canvas to review changes made.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance- Alert improvements
items.text: Communication Compliance is improving the capabilities and customization of policy alerts. Admins will be able to customize the alert frequency per policy as well as adjust the email alerts frequency and recipients within the policy creation wizard. Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance provides the tools to help organizations detect regulatory compliance violations (for example SEC or FINRA), such as sensitive or confidential information, harassing or threatening language, and sharing of adult content. Built with privacy by design, usernames are pseudonymized by default, role-based access controls are built in, investigators are opted in by an admin, and audit logs are in place to ensu

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Communication Compliance - Alert improvements
items.text: This feature is about improving the alerting capabilities and customization in Communication Compliance.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Show your shared content on both room displays
items.text: Make presentations easier to see from anywhere in the room, even when you're not in a Teams meeting. On Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android with dual displays, content you share through an HDMI connection can now appear on both screens at once. You can start or stop showing your content on both screens from the room controls. Admins can use settings to manage how this works in their rooms.

items.title: SharePoint: Organization-wide page templates
items.text: We are introducing organization-wide page templates in SharePoint, enabling organizations to provide reusable, approved starting points for page creation across sites within a tenant. Managed centrally in the SharePoint site associated with your organization's brand center, these templates help authors reduce repetitive setup and create pages with consistent content.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
items.text: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Increase in expansion limit for auto-expanding archive beyond 1.5 TB
items.text: Previously, auto-expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archives beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling per-policy coverage report
items.text: For each enforced auto-labeling policy, admins can view how files processed during enforcement correlate to the latest simulation run. The per-policy coverage report shows volumes of files that have been labeled or are not yet labeled, and whether those files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This helps admins understand enforcement progress for a specific policy against the data state captured during simulation, while also identifying files that were not found in the simulation snapshot but were processed during enforcement.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
items.text: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports (U.S. Government clouds)
items.text: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved device settings experience on Teams Rooms on Android
items.text: We’re enhancing the on-device admin settings experience for Teams Rooms on Android by improving information structure, organization and navigation. These updates make it easier for admins to find, understand, and adjust device settings directly from the console, improving overall usability and efficiency in room management.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
items.text: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Enable version trimming for data covered by retention policies in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.text: Let tenants trim file-version bloat created by retention, without breaking compliance promises. SharePoint/compliance admins at large, regulated enterprises must cap and reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions, while keeping legal-hold and records promises intact. Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC can enable version cleanup for ODB/SPO content even when retention policies are in effect. This would be a policy scoped setting that essentially overrides the default behavior where all versions are retained. When turned on, SharePoint’s version management will be permitted to trim file versions per the defined limits except for specific protected cases.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Apply Purview network data security DLP policies to all websites, or all websites except specific cloud apps, through Entra GSA Internet Access integration
items.text: With this feature, admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites ( . ) or all websites except specific cloud apps, allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.text: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.text: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
items.text: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.text: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
items.text: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validation. As part of this change, the connector setup no longer provisions an Entra service principal or issues a shared secret on the customer's behalf. Customers should plan to register an Entra ID appli

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.text: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint files under retention
items.text: We are introducing file archiving support in SharePoint Online, utilizing this feature administrators can seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins can now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SharePoint Online. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
items.text: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications in case of any data loss incident that may occur due to a misconfigured policy or regression. Priority Cleanup feature allows users to bypass retention, and eDiscovery holds to help customers comply

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
items.text: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications in case of any data loss incident that may occur due to a misconfigured policy or regression. items.title: Manage workforce requests in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.text: Dynamics 365 Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) integrates with Microsoft 365 Copilot through Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. These tools connect Microsoft 365 Copilot with Dynamics 365 and Dataverse so supervisors and customer service representatives can use natural language to work with workforce requests. Supervisors can list and filter the time-off, shift-swap, and shift-bid requests they are authorized to access. They can open an individual request to review its details and scheduling context. Supervisors with the required reviewer permission can also approve or reject pending time-off requests. When a supervisor rejects a request, the reason is saved as the reviewer note. The de

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Set and manage meeting timers in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.text: Keep meetings on track with a shared countdown timer in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows. Start, pause, resume, or cancel a timer from the room’s touch console, with the countdown visible on the front-of-room display and in participants’ meeting views. Available with a Teams Rooms Pro license.

items.title: Exchange: Enable High Volume Email (HVE) for External Recipients
items.text: High Volume Email (HVE) External Sending extends HVE in Exchange Online, which today sends only to recipients inside your organization, so it can also deliver bulk email to external recipients such as customers and partners. It is designed for operational and transactional messages, like notifications, alerts, receipts and required communications, and not for marketing campaigns. Apps and devices send through SMTP using HVE account authentication. Admins turn the feature on for specific HVE accounts with a cmdlet. Built-in throttling, quotas and suppression of problem recipients help protect your sending reputation. Billing will be based on usage, per external recipient.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Configure a list of allowed external meeting notetaker bots for your Teams meetings
items.text: Admins will be able to configure more granular and advanced controls for managing external bots and their access to meetings hosted in their organization. Admins will be able to configure a list of external meeting bots which are allowed to join meetings hosted in their organization. Admins can also opt to block all other bots or let them be enforced into the currently available high friction lobby experience. The allowed bots will be treated like a regular external participant to the meeting and meeting policies will be enforced as appropriate.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
items.text: Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center. Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn , providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. New reports and capabilities will continue to be released. These reports can be used with Power Platform API credit allocations to monitor and optimize resources and environments that consume Copilot Credits.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password from the context menu
items.text: Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically. When a user right-clicks a recognized username or password field, a new Select Password option appears in the context menu. This provides a reliable fallback path for sign-in scenarios where autofill suggestions are not surfaced, reducing the need for users to copy credentials manually. No configuration is required, and existing password management policies continue to apply.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
items.text: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.text: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
items.text: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
items.text: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent - Sensitive Data Remediation through Microsoft Teams
items.text: The Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention now offers a new sensitive data remediation function, which empowers organizations to proactively identify and remediate sensitive information—such as Social Security Numbers, passwords, and credit card data—across thousands of files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive locations, dramatically increasing the percentage of remediated files with sensitive information, resulting in reduced compliance risk. Seamlessly integrated with Microsoft Purview, this new agent function automatically detects file(s) with a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy match “Needs Attention” alerts and pushes a remediation notification to the end user who last modifie

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
items.text: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
items.text: Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it. Share from the workflows page or the designer. Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing. See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share. Co-owners can edit and run the workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
items.text: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts
items.text: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This ensures content generated during meetings is consistently protected without requiring manual labeling, reducing risk and simplifying protection at scale.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.text: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Introducing IRM Alert classification
items.text: Insider risk management will be introducing the ability to classify alerts as True positive, Benign (operational), and False positive. This will be available on all alerts where authorized analysts with the appropriate permissions can choose from a list of predefined classification reasons. Alert classification will help tenants to better classify risk within alerts to support reporting and tuning needs. This will replace existing dismissal reasons.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
items.text: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing and acting on detection signals from supported providers.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
items.text: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.text: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing software investments and unlocks more surfaces for the tools their users already rely on.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
items.text: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

items.title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
items.text: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
items.text: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: EDU tenant type selection in policy wizard
items.text: Admins can now select tenant type for their institution from the policy wizard. This setting can be changed anytime from the wizard.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Create full-workload backup policies for Microsoft 365 Backup
items.text: Automatically backup all Exchange or OneDrive users and/or SharePoint sites in the tenant and have the tool automatically add new users/sites to the backup policy.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 admin centers –  Manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and Microsoft 365 App
items.text: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App will be able to apply their changes across all three clients (Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App). Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, management of these apps will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.text: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: False positive email release from Quarantine through threat explorer, email summary panel, advanced hunting, and custom detection email entity page take action
items.text: SecOps can now mange False positives and take move to inbox (i.e. release) quarantined messages from Threat explorer, advanced hunting, custom detection and Email entity page without the need to tab out to the Quarantine portal to take the action.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Service Agent in Microsoft 365 - your dedicated service specialist
items.text: • Rapid onboarding to a hybrid workforce:Service Agent in Microsoft 365 can be hired and onboard with your company's knowledge sources, communication guidelines and escalation rules etc. in minutes. Manager can choose the semi or full autonomous mode. • 24/7 support: Natively connects to Microsoft 365 ecosystem, accessing real-time data, documents, CRM records and thousands of knowledge connectors. Handles customer inquiries 24/7 with consistent quality and context, improving resolution rates and customer satisfaction over time. • Secure and Compliant: Built from A365 platform and natively leverage WorkIQ, Service Agent in Microsoft 365 has both the intelligence of customer’s enterprise know

items.title: Work IQ: Granular MCP policies
items.text: Provide granular policies that restrict MCP access to trusted platforms, workloads, and supported operations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Improved sensitive information types
items.text: Improved Microsoft out-of-the-box sensitive information types (SITs) to identify sensitive data more precisely and reliably.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: recurring classifier refresh
items.text: Evolve On-Demand Classification into recurring classification refreshes that help keep existing content classification current as data and context change.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Protect sensitive data across agent-to-human and agent-to-tool interactions with expanded DLP controls across local agents
items.text: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) now expands inline protection to supported local AI agents, helping safeguard sensitive data across human-to-agent and agent-to-tool interactions. Organizations can apply DLP policies to prompts, files, and tool interactions to block policy-violating data movement at supported interaction points. These controls help prevent sensitive data exposure as AI agents access enterprise information and act on users’ behalf.

items.title: Power Apps: Build model-driven apps with Copilot Cowork
items.text: Information workers can now use model-app-builder skill in Copilot Cowork to create and refine model-driven apps from natural-language requirements. Cowork turns a business scenario into an app specification and build plan for review before creating the model-driven app and its supporting Power Apps and Microsoft Dataverse artifacts. By handling repetitive artifact creation, makers can move from an idea to a working app fast and spend more time refining the app's design and business experience. Makers can continue iterating through conversation in Cowork or open the generated artifacts in Power Apps for direct customization.
